summary.text: Mike Clines is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 68 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a former school superintendent and educational consultant.

paragraphs.text: Mike Clines earned a bachelor's degree in secondary education and teaching/English from Northern Kentucky University and a master's degree in educational leadership and administration from the University of Cincinnati in 1998.

His career has included work as an English teacher and coach at Covington Catholic High School, as superintendent of schools of the Diocese of Covington, and as an educational consultant with Leadership Squared LLC.
Clines has served on the board of the Go Norse Fund, on the School of Education Advisory Board of Xavier University, and as chair of the ACT Kentucky State Organization.
Clines took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2023, succeeding Joseph Fischer.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Banking and Insurance Committee, the Committee on Families and Children, the Licensing, Occupations, and Administrative Regulations Committee, and the Primary and Secondary Education Committee, where he is vice chair.
